nodes.description: Public uint8 state variable holding the minimum percentage increase required for each successive bid.
Public uint256 state variable for the fee percentage paid to the haus address on settlement.
Public uint256 state variable identifying the ERC1155 token being auctioned.
Public address of the ERC1155 contract holding the auctioned asset.
Public boolean latch marking whether the auction has already been finalized.
Public address authorized to call pull() when no bids exist.
Public address recording the deployer of the auction contract.
Public uint256 holding the current highest bid / reserve price.
Public payable address of the current highest bidder.
Public uint256 auction duration constant (24 hours) set on first bid.
Public uint256 timestamp when the auction started (first reserve-meeting bid).
Public uint256 timestamp when the auction ends, extended on late bids.
Public payable address receiving the protocol fee.
Public payable address of the NFT seller receiving sale proceeds.
Public payable bid function: refunds previous winner, enforces minimum increase, updates lastBid/winning and auction timing.
Public finalization function transferring the ERC1155 to the winner and splitting ETH between haus and seller.
Controller-only function returning the ERC1155 to the seller when no bids were placed.
Public view returning true while block.timestamp < endTime.
Public view returning true if the contract holds the auctioned ERC1155 token.
External pure ERC1155 receiver hook returning the acceptance selector; callback entry point.
Constructor initializing token, reserve price, fee percentages, addresses and deployer.
Caller-controlled address used for bidder identity, controller checks and deployer assignment.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving auction start, end, extension and liveness checks.
Origin address compared against msg.sender to block contract callers.
External ETH transfer of lastBid to the previously winning bidder inside bid().
External ETH transfer of the protocol fee to haus inside end().
External ETH transfer of the remaining contract balance to seller inside end().
External IERC1155.safeTransferFrom call delivering the NFT to the winner in end().
External IERC1155.safeTransferFrom call returning the NFT to the seller in pull().
External IERC1155.balanceOf call used by containsAuctionNFT().
SafeMath computation lastBid.mul(multiplier).div(100) producing the minimum acceptable bid.
SafeMath computation balance.div(100).mul(hausFeePercentage) producing the protocol fee.
SafeMath computation base.add(percentageIncreasePerBid) producing the bid multiplier.
Timestamp arithmetic comparing endTime - now < 15 minutes and setting endTime = now + 15 minutes.
Timestamp arithmetic startTime + length initializing endTime on the first valid bid.
Constructor parameter for the auctioned ERC1155 token id.
Constructor parameter for the ERC1155 contract address.
Constructor parameter initializing the reserve price / starting lastBid.
Constructor parameter for the protocol fee percentage.
Constructor parameter for the per-bid percentage increase.
Constructor parameter for the seller payout address.
Constructor parameter for the protocol fee recipient.
Constructor parameter for the controller address.
Local uint8 constant 100 used as the percentage base in bid().
Local uint256 holding base + percentageIncreasePerBid in bid().
Local uint256 holding the computed protocol fee in end().
Local uint256 snapshot of address(this).balance in end().

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against tx.origin in require(msg.sender == tx.origin) gating bid().
tx.origin is used as an anti-contract identity check inside bid().
block.timestamp drives the start/end checks and the 15-minute extension inside bid().
live() returns block.timestamp < endTime, making auction liveness timestamp dependent.
end() requires !live(), so its execution is controlled by the timestamp-derived liveness flag.
pull() requires !live(), so its execution is controlled by the timestamp-derived liveness flag.
block.timestamp is assigned to startTime on the first reserve-meeting bid.
block.timestamp contributes to endTime through the extension logic.
endTime is derived from startTime plus length.
The 24-hour length variable is added to startTime to form endTime.
startTime + length arithmetic writes endTime.
block.timestamp feeds the endTime - now / now + 15 minutes extension arithmetic.
The timestamp extension arithmetic overwrites endTime.
percentageIncreasePerBid is added to base to derive the multiplier.
Local base (100) is the left operand of base.add(percentageIncreasePerBid).
The base.add(...) arithmetic result is stored in the multiplier local.
multiplier is the argument to lastBid.mul(multiplier).div(100).
lastBid is multiplied and divided to compute the minimum required bid.
The computed minimum bid result gates bid() via require(msg.value >= ...).
The multiplier arithmetic is executed inside bid().
winning is assigned msg.sender at the end of bid().
bid() writes the winning bidder state variable.
bid() overwrites lastBid with msg.value after refunding the previous bidder.
The winning address is the recipient of the ETH refund external call.
lastBid is the ETH amount sent to the previous winner.
bid() performs an external ETH transfer to the previous winner before finalizing lastBid/winning, enabling reentrancy.
end() requires !ended to prevent repeated finalization.
pull() requires !ended to prevent repeated finalization.
end() requires winning != address(0).
pull() requires winning == address(0) so no bids were placed.
controller is the authorized address compared in pull().
msg.sender must equal controller to execute pull().
end() makes an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom call, invoking the receiver hook.
pull() makes an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom call to the seller.
end() sends the haus fee via external ETH transfer before setting ended = true.
end() sends the remaining balance to seller via external ETH transfer before setting ended = true.
The local balance snapshot is the base of balance.div(100).mul(hausFeePercentage).
hausFeePercentage multiplies the balance/100 result to compute the fee.
The fee arithmetic result is stored in the local hausFee.
The computed hausFee is the amount transferred to haus.
The seller address receives the remaining contract balance.
end() sets ended = true only after all external transfers complete.
pull() sets ended = true after returning the NFT.
tokenAddress is the target contract of the ERC1155 transfer in end().
tokenId identifies the NFT transferred in end().
tokenAddress is the target contract of the ERC1155 transfer in pull().
tokenId identifies the NFT transferred back to the seller in pull().
seller is the destination address of the NFT transfer in pull().
tokenAddress is the target of the balanceOf external call.
tokenId is passed to balanceOf in containsAuctionNFT().
containsAuctionNFT() executes the external balanceOf call.
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom triggers the onERC1155Received hook on the recipient, a potential reentrancy path.
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom triggers the onERC1155Received hook on the seller contract.
Constructor parameter _tokenId initializes tokenId.
Constructor parameter _tokenAddress initializes tokenAddress.
Constructor parameter _reservePriceWei initializes lastBid.
Constructor parameter _hausFeePercentage initializes hausFeePercentage.
Constructor parameter _percentageIncreasePerBid initializes percentageIncreasePerBid.
Constructor parameter _sellerAddress initializes seller.
Constructor parameter _hausAddress initializes haus.
Constructor parameter _controllerAddress initializes controller.
msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to set deployer.
The constructor writes the deployer state variable.
